levers.name: terminal growth stored as real rates on the house UAE path
levers.why: the two stages carried typed nominals of 2.5% and 1.5% and this study committed no macro record, so nothing held them to the house path
levers.evidence: THIS LEVER MOVES NO NUMBER, and the reason is the finding: this company's tariff is regulated and NOT indexed, so nominal revenue growth IS volume growth and the typed rates reproduce exactly as +0.49% and -0.49% real on the house 2.0% inflation. What it buys is a reader who can see that stage two assumes the business shrinks in real terms for ever — which the study describes as 'about zero real tariff growth' without ever naming the rate
